title: chaetanthera depauperata
intro: Chaetanthera depauperata, commonly known as the New Zealand chaetanthera, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. The health benefits associated with Chaetanthera depauperata include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of allergies and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antihistamine properties. The bioactive constituents of Chaetanthera depauperata include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
